name: Civilization: The Firekeeper's Bone
description: Ancient bone carving over a 37-symbol alphabet (abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_). Even i: shift forward by (i+7) mod 37; Odd i: shift backward by (i*3+5) mod 37. Cipher: Ygxf3{pehxkqspkh8vyntf50h_qg1w}. Download cipher.txt.
hints: Hint 1: Alphabet has 37 symbols (0 pts) | Hint 2: Invert even positions by subtracting (i+7)%37, odd by adding (i*3+5)%37 (10 pts) | Hint 3: Python loop with alphabet indexing (25 pts)

name: Civilization: The Diplomat's Oath
description: Secret letter carried to Paris protected by an Autokey cipher starting with primer PARIS. Keystream is fed by decrypted message letters: K_i = P_{i-5}. Cipher: Gofbk{rihhces_wspiyww_fm_pkgmxizbs}. Download cipher.txt.
hints: Hint 1: Primer PARIS unlocks first 5 letters, each decrypted letter extends the key (0 pts) | Hint 2: Decrypt letter-by-letter sequentially (10 pts) | Hint 3: keystream.append(p_char) as each letter is decrypted (25 pts)

name: Civilization: The Granary Ledger
description: Ancient clay accounting tablet using an Affine cipher over a 37-symbol alphabet: E(x) = (a*x + b) mod 37. Cipher: Z33k_{hntv7uzmuzyk0hjkyimy_m_vdjzynz}. Download cipher.txt and affine.py.
hints: Hint 1: Prime modulus 37, 36*37=1332 keys (0 pts) | Hint 2: Test all keys in Python using pow(a, -1, 37) (10 pts) | Hint 3: Keys are a=11, b=23 (25 pts)

name: Civilization: The Sentry's Clockwork
description: Bronze clockwork gate machine using an LCG formula: S_{i+1} = (137*S_i + 73) mod 256. Starting seed S_0 is between 0 and 255. Cipher hex: 78accb794d0c9462b5f4bc0788387f1a0ea780eed12e3b8e564b2c1a45424455a61e. Download cipher.txt and xor.py.
hints: Hint 1: Number sequence is S_{i+1}=(137*S_i + 73)%256 with seed 0..255 (0 pts) | Hint 2: Test all 256 seeds in Python and check for Roots{ (10 pts) | Hint 3: Seed is 42 (25 pts)

name: Civilization: The Transatlantic Cable
description: Undersea telegraph messages encrypted with One-Time Pad key reuse: C1 ^ C2 = P1 ^ P2. Message 1 known prefix: 'OPERATION CIPHERFALL: '. Download ciphertexts.txt and encrypt.py.
hints: Hint 1: Key reuse allows XOR recovery (0 pts) | Hint 2: XOR C1 with 'OPERATION CIPHERFALL: ' reveals key start (10 pts) | Hint 3: Message 1 is 'OPERATION CIPHERFALL: AGENT VANCE ESCAPED VIA SECTOR 04!' (25 pts)

name: Civilization: The Vanguard Satellite
description: Space satellite Diffie-Hellman handshake: p=19997, g=5, A=2058, B=5125. Key = SHA256(str(S)). Encrypted hex: e8b0b0ee8118a4d6798cb4250c440a0be36b4c5f12ab10fca062f1a3471946a189bba2. Download params.txt and dh.py.
hints: Hint 1: Find Alice's secret number 'a' with pow(5, a, 19997)==2058 (0 pts) | Hint 2: Shared secret S = pow(B, a, p), derive key with SHA256 (10 pts) | Hint 3: a=13371, S=18857 (25 pts)

name: Civilization: The Digital Gold Vault
description: Digital bank vault RSA-512 lock where prime sum S = p + q is known. Use simple algebra (p-q)^2 = S^2 - 4*N to factor modulus and decrypt. Download rsa.txt and encrypt.py.
hints: Hint 1: (p - q)^2 = S^2 - 4*N (0 pts) | Hint 2: math.isqrt(S*S - 4*N) gives p - q (10 pts) | Hint 3: Recover p, q, compute phi and d=pow(e,-1,phi) (25 pts)

name: Civilization: The Connected World
description: Global network router cipher using AES S-Box, nibble swapping, and 2 round keys run for only 1 round. Invert each step in reverse order. Download cipher.txt and chall.py.
hints: Hint 1: A single SPN round can be undone step by step backwards (0 pts) | Hint 2: Swapping nibbles twice returns the original byte (10 pts) | Hint 3: XOR with K1, swap nibbles, invert S-Box, XOR with K0 (25 pts)
